scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,track,web -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @cdt/server" "npm run dev:worker -w @cdt/server" "npm run dev:tracking -w @cdt/server" "npm run dev -w @cdt/web"
scripts.db:setup: npm exec -w @cdt/server -- prisma migrate dev --name init && npm exec -w @cdt/server -- prisma db seed
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cdt/server && npm run build -w @cdt/web
